title: Cantor Selindra
group: The Hour of the Last Eclipse
summary: Gather close to the Cantor before the surrounding shadows strike.
overview: Cantor Selindra occupies the Castle Wings. Her shadow pulse shelters raiders near her, requiring ranged players and healers to close the distance on command.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Keep Selindra accessible so the raid can gather around her.
Avoid repositioning her away from the gathering raid during the warning.

roles.label: Healers
tips: Move within 20 paces of Selindra before the warning ends.
Choose a position that allows healing while remaining inside the sheltered area.

roles.label: Damage dealers
tips: Ranged players should close in immediately when the shadows deepen.
Bring pets inside the sheltered area as well.

phases.label: Break the Choir Seal
phases.description: A gathering warning repeats every 22 seconds. After six seconds, the pulse strikes targets more than 20 and up to 180 paces from Selindra.

abilities.name: Sheltering Shadows
abilities.summary: Gather within 20 paces of Selindra before the six-second warning ends.
description: Selindra is the center of the sheltered area when the pulse resolves. Stay close enough to follow if she moves.
Raiders and pets outside the sheltered area but within the outer pulse radius can be struck if they have line of sight to its center.

sections.title: Stay in the battle
paragraphs: Fight near the boss's home. Raiders and their pets must remain within 180 paces of the boss and within 30 paces vertically; attacks and aid from outside that boundary are rejected.
If no eligible living raider remains in the arena, or the boss is pulled too far from home, a warning precedes an encounter reset. Keep healers and resurrection targets inside the battle.

sections.title: Read the warnings
paragraphs: Mechanic warnings appear in the Event Messages chat filter. Movement mechanics give six seconds to respond.
Ground markers can supplement the warning when supported and enabled. Follow the chat instruction even if a marker is absent.

loot.title: Equipment
loot.description: One item is selected from this six-item pool.

loot.title: Guardian relic
loot.description: Two copies accompany the equipment reward.

notes: Reviewed against the local quest working tree. The encounter script contains uncommitted changes beyond the recorded Git revision; the file hashes identify the exact reviewed bytes.
Mechanics, item definitions and loot pools were checked in source. This review does not establish which revision, database templates or settings are deployed on the live server.
Role tips are guidance derived from the scripted mechanics, not a strategy verified in a live raid. Pulse damage is omitted because it depends on the NPC's loaded spell scale.
Ability names describe scripted mechanics. The damage pulses are not ordinary database spells and do not have spell tooltip IDs.
